title: Kirkpatrick: metallic orbs worldwide, said at NASA panel

tellings.quote: Kurt Patrick, former director of Aeros said uh quote, "We're seeing metallic orbs, direct quote, making very interesting apparent maneuvers all over the world."

plain: A guest named Merrick, on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, quotes Sean Kirkpatrick, the former head of AARO, the Pentagon's office for investigating unexplained aerial reports. According to Merrick, Kirkpatrick said at a 2023 NASA panel on these sightings that they were seeing metallic orbs making very interesting apparent maneuvers all over the world. If true, it would mean the government's own investigator saw something unexplained happening worldwide.
